reviews.review_description:
It has everything to make your dreams come true. 
Build a  business to promote sugar addiction - you got it! 
Punch some cookies without getting crumbs in the bed - oh yeah! 
Have a workout while motivating your employees - you bet!

(Review not generated by AI)

This is a very interesting game, calming in its own way. I really liked it, partly because of its simplicity. But it's too short. I literally bought all the upgrades in half an hour. In an hour, I made almost 300,000 cookies, and I have almost 200,000 coins in my account. And I have absolutely no idea what to do next. What I'd like is to please improve the graphics, because they're very basic now. Add more content to the game, because it's only half an hour and it's all sad. Also, the roulette is a scam; I got 50 coins in 7 tries. The character moves very slowly, and because I'm tall, it was a bit difficult until I found the button to increase my cookies. I still give it 5 stars because it's only $1, but I'd like to keep playing. I hope you'll add more content soon so I can come back to the game every night and not feel like there's no point in playing anymore because there's nothing to strive for. It was really fun, though, thanks for playing.

And also, a small request, if you change the balance in the game to extend it, then please add the ability to start a new game so that I can complete it without the current huge balance.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a detailed review! I'm really glad you enjoyed the game and that you found it relaxing and fun, even if you reached the end of the current content quickly.

I'm a solo developer working on this project in my spare time, so progress takes a bit longer than I'd like. My main strength is programming rather than art and graphical design, but I definitely plan to keep adding more content, progression, and things to work toward. I'll also do my best to improve the visuals over time.

I also appreciate your feedback about the roulette, movement speed, and the reset option. A "New Game" feature is a great suggestion, especially for players who want to experience the progression again after balance changes, and I'll keep it in mind for a future update.

Thanks again for your support and for giving the game a chance. Reviews like yours really help me prioritize what to work on next, and I hope you'll come back to see how the game evolves!
